_comment: Scenarios from HELD-OUT recorded episodes of the trained policy (use with --episodes <logdir>/eval_eps --min-return 600), at SHORT horizons. Why: random-action scenarios measure a flailing walker falling over (easy), and long horizons are saturated: on competent walking both Dreamer models scored ~0.02 skill at 5 s, because DreamerV3 is trained to imagine ~15 steps (<1 s) ahead, not to free-run for seconds. The informative range is sub-second to a few seconds, so the horizons here stop at 5 s. 12 scenarios; `seed` picks the episode and the start offset deterministically, and the horizons of one scenario are nested prefixes of one window. `prompt` is only a label. Requires episodes with at least 5 context + 100 frames.
